page_hero.headline: The Burnaby Entrepreneurs Gala
page_hero.intro: Once a year we put on our best and celebrate the speeches, the awards, and the members behind them.

headline: The Burnaby Entrepreneurs Gala
lead: Once a year we put on our best and celebrate the speeches, the awards, and the members behind them. Registration for the next Gala opens later this year — until then, look back at how the last one went.
note: Next year's registration isn't open yet. Attend a Wednesday meeting and we'll tell you first.

rows.heading: A room full of familiar faces
rows.text: The 2025 Gala opened with warm welcomes and reconnections as members, guests, and alumni gathered for the evening.

rows.heading: Set for the night
rows.text: Tables set, lights dimmed, and the room ready for a night celebrating a year of speeches and growth.

rows.heading: Raising a glass
rows.text: A toast to the year's members — new voices, returning speakers, and the mentors who kept the room honest.

rows.heading: The evening begins
rows.text: Our MC welcomed the room, walked through the program, and set the tone: celebrate the year, honour the speakers, share the wins.

rows.heading: Voices from the year
rows.text: Prepared speeches from members of the year — the ones who logged the practice, took the notes, and came back the next Wednesday.

rows.heading: Speaker of the Year
rows.text: The Speaker of the Year award recognises the member who set the standard on the lectern this year.

rows.heading: Evaluator of the Year
rows.text: Great evaluation is a craft. This award celebrates the member whose feedback made everyone else better.

rows.heading: Rookie of the Year
rows.text: Every year one new member stands out for the progress they made from Icebreaker to today. This is that member.

rows.heading: The President's Award
rows.text: For the member whose leadership, mentorship, or service shaped the club this year.

rows.heading: Members of the year
rows.text: A group shot with the members who carried the program this year — the officers, mentors, and regulars.

rows.heading: Around the table
rows.text: Between the speeches, the awards, and the toasts — the part of the evening where the real conversations happen.

rows.heading: Friends of the club
rows.text: Guests from partner clubs, past members, and the friends and families who came along for the celebration.

rows.heading: The evening's hosts
rows.text: Our Toastmaster and General Evaluator kept the evening moving on time and on tone.

rows.heading: See you next year
rows.text: The last of the applause, the last of the photos, and a room already looking forward to 2026.

video.heading: The night, in two minutes
video.text: A short highlight from the 2025 Gala — the speeches, the awards, the room. Best watched with the volume up.
